name: Orchid-Scented Taiping Houkui Reserve
marketing_tip: A premium selection of hand-pinched Taiping Houkui with a distinct orchid fragrance.
body: This half-pound gift set features Taiping Houkui leaves known for their 'Orchid Fragrance'. Carefully hand-pinched to preserve their integrity, these leaves produce a bright, flavorful tea that is a favorite among green tea lovers.
